test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). F is sitting second to right of D. C is sitting third to left of F. B is sitting to the immediate right of D. A is not an immediate neighbour of C. How many people are sitting between E and B when counted from right of E?
solution: Given, Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). F is sitting second to right of D. C is sitting third to left of F. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0890c7009dbc5c69f717d2275d8d91e56dd2aafd56ac8a03acd1871aae38953.png] B is sitting to the immediate right of D.
